interface.shortDescription: Cross-platform CNKI research for Codex and Claude.
interface.longDescription: Controls a dedicated Google Chrome profile on macOS, Windows, and Linux, searches CNKI through the Nanjing University of the Arts proxy, extracts literature metadata, downloads accessible papers, reads CNKI AI full text, and produces structured critical summaries in Codex or Claude Code.
